create_merged_dataset: create a MergeDataset instance that merges samples from multiple datasets into single combined samples
merge_distinct_keys: merge datasets with distinct keys so each key from each dataset appears in the final sample dict
merge_matching_keys: merge datasets with matching keys so values are collected into a list under the shared key
test_merge_dataset_length: test that the MergeDataset length equals the length of the first underlying dataset
review_merge_dataset_getitem: review the MergeDataset __getitem__ method to understand how it merges dict samples from multiple datasets
